violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Surfaces of the can opener bald and can opener stand, were in contact with non-time/temperature control for safety food items that were observed soiled with accumulations of grime and debris. The can opener stand was also noted top be soiled with build-up debris and grimes.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at any time when contamination may have occurred. CORRETED DURING THE INPSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: RANCH (made on site)
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. (Discarded)

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor, in the wall-in freezer and in the dry storage room.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean single service cups ands lifts stored on the floor in the dry storage room, were they are exposed to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor drain under the 3-compartment sink, is soiled with debris and crusted materials, is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at ware washing g. Station’s handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CORRECTED DURIG THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at WARE WASHING STATION’S handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CORRECTED DURING TGHE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: ALFREDO SAUCE=47F, MEATBALL=50F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. (Discarded)

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The 4-door Pizza prep table refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F at the bottom compartment.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the bottom compartment of this unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Vocelli Pizza #148 (Inspection Date: 08/05/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk /Soda crates found used as storage racks at the back work area.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. Replace these creates with peripheral racks.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the hand washing sink located at the 3-compartment station, is in need of cleaning. Also, the freezer drain hose on the walk-in freezer, that is draining into the hand washing sink, should be be redirected to the floor drain for proper draining to prevent the contamination of the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. maintain this sink and all other sinks in clean condition at all times. Also, crease the water flow at the sink.
